text:
Tessa: Heads-up: Invoice INV-2026-0042 (BlueHarbor) is 28 days past due. ACH hit failed on 2026-03-10 (fail_9f3b). Balance $48,750. Need payment plan decision.
Omar: I talked to their CFO just now. They requested to split into three installments over the next 60 days and want late fees waived if they don't miss any scheduled payments.
Kelly: Relationship has been good; they had an unexpected spike in usage. I'm leaning toward a short plan. Conditions: require ACH mandate + first payment before we lift restrictions.
Ravi: What protections do we need if they default? Any collateral or a right to suspend?
Tessa: Current facts:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-0042
Total: $48,750
Issued: 2026-02-05
Due: 2026-03-08
Failed ACH: 2026-03-10 (fail_9f3b)
```
Proposal: 3 installments (30% / 30% / 40%) due 2026-04-05, 2026-05-05, 2026-06-05. Waive late fees only if first payment clears on 2026-04-05 and all subsequent payments clear on schedule. Place account on provisioning restriction and pause Premier Support until first payment posts.
Omar: They asked for a short written confirmation to sign and an ACH pull authorization. Will get CFO to sign if we send MOU.
Kelly: Draft looks fine. We should require a signed ACH mandate and set an automatic hold to trigger if Payment 1 fails.
Ravi: Legal should attach a 1-page MOU stating the conditional waiver and remedies on default. I approve with those conditions. No permanent fee waivers.
Tessa: Draft message to customer below 94 please review before I send:
"Hi BlueHarbor team,

Per our conversation, Redwood Inference agrees to a three-installment payment schedule for invoice INV-2026-0042 (total $48,750):
- Payment 1: $14,625 due 2026-04-05 (ACH)
- Payment 2: $14,625 due 2026-05-05 (ACH)
- Payment 3: $19,500 due 2026-06-05 (ACH)

Conditions: (1) First payment must clear by 2026-04-05 or the account will be placed on suspension and late fees will apply; (2) Late-fee waiver will only apply if all scheduled payments clear on the dates above; (3) Provisioning will remain restricted until the first payment posts.

Please reply with your authorization to pull the first ACH on 2026-04-05 and attach a signed ACH mandate and contact for billing.

Best,
Tessa, Finance Ops"

Kelly: I'll attach the payment schedule PDF and send. Omar please confirm when you receive the signed mandate.
Omar: CFO said they'll return the signed mandate by EOD tomorrow. I'll post an update here when I have it.
collections-bot: Reminder set: Payment 1 (INV-2026-0042) due 2026-04-05. Automated reminder email scheduled for 2026-03-29.
